title: Approval policy has fewer than two approvers

minApprovers.text: Approvers required before the control is dependable

report.title: {Items.Count} approval {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy has', 'policies have')} too few approvers

messages.businessImpact: With a single approver, one person's absence blocks every change and one person's account compromise defeats the control entirely.
remediation: Add at least one more member to the approver group for each policy listed.
Avoid using a group whose only members are the same people who author policies.
messages.cannotSee: A policy whose approver groups could not be read is passed over rather than counted as having none.
